decision: Exit predicate: worktrees pruned, seek-flush plan landed, swift test clean but for the three known baseline failures, simulator presentation regression green
why: autonomous run needs a checkable stop condition before the first iteration

decision: Both worktree branches are already ancestors of main; only their uncommitted edits need merging
why: git merge-base --is-ancestor returned true for both, so no branch merge is owed
result: 2 branches merged, 27 uncommitted files to carry over

decision: Landed both worktrees as four commits and finished the photo removal the source change left dangling
why: the branches were merged but their working trees held real unmerged edits, and the journey ledger still drove two identifiers the product no longer publishes

decision: Treated format-description-identity and reachability-inventory as pre-existing gate failures, not merge damage
why: both fail identically at 1a203ce in a clean worktree, and the 15 uncovered reachability cells are all from recent player work, none photo related
result: attributed, needs a device matrix run

decision: Skipped a fresh architect pass and executed the plan as written
why: the plan is already an evidence-backed design from a measured sweep; re-exploring it would re-litigate a settled decision

decision: Bounded the video lane by decoded frames and left the audio lane in media seconds
why: the flush cost the plan measured is a property of the decoded video queue; audio decodes small and flushes cheaply, so seconds is still the right unit there

decision: Found the two remaining structure failures are TestMedia corpus growth, not code
why: the baseline counts classifications, and the new vectors carry codecs the product already declares unrenderable

decision: Landed the frame-count gate; swift test clean but for the three baseline failures across three consecutive runs
why: one clean run could not tell a flake from a regression, and one did appear and vanish

decision: Rejected the delegate's cut of scheduling slack from two frames to one
why: its own reason was that the floor masked the byte difference at 8K, but at one frame the floor still masks it; two is what keeps a frame in transit while the provider read blocks the loop

decision: Corrected my own budget test instead of the code when it failed at slack 2
why: the test demanded ten-bit 8K get fewer frames than eight-bit, but the plan predicts both pin to the reorder floor there
result: test now checks 4K separation and the 8K floor

decision: Fixed the matrix clean-verify, which compared against a bare filename while the product reports reference=<name>
why: the script had copied the product's shape into its own constant and drifted; the repo warns these checkers do exactly that
result: cell reaches playback instead of failing at setup

decision: Attributed the open-default WRONG_STATE to pre-existing behaviour, not the gate rewrite
why: built 1a203ce in a worktree and ran the same cell; every control-plane field matches except the sample count, which is just elapsed time

decision: Confirmed the frame gate delivers on the simulator
why: lifecycle Playing with 2155 accepted samples, displayedPixel true and no renderer error, on the 8K60 clip the plan was written for

decision: Used the clean-* path family, which is the one written for --clean runs
why: the portal-on-open expectation belongs to the non-clean family; picking it was my error, not script drift

decision: Format switch to 180 side-by-side keeps playing through the renderer rebuild
why: this is the playback state transition the gate rewrite could most plausibly have broken

decision: Panorama entry stalls identically at 1a203ce and HEAD on the simulator
why: no ARKit session there, so the spatial probe is never written; the lane cannot answer this question either way

decision: Device measured leadFrames 48 on an 8K stream, which exposed the budget inputs arriving as zero
why: the self-evidence field the plan insisted on carrying is what caught it; a seconds-era build would have looked fine

decision: Pinned the probe's derived data after it silently reinstalled a stale build
why: ensure-session fell back to the controller default path and the device reverted to the pre-rewrite app, which reported the old fields
result: measurements now come from the build under test

decision: 8K60 seek flush is 0.7 to 0.9 ms at 4 frames, against 240.8 ms at the old 0.75 second lead
why: this is the number the whole plan was written to move

decision: Device clean-spatial-cycle PASS: window to portal to panorama twice and back
why: this is the presentation coverage the simulator lane cannot answer, and the one the gate rewrite most plausibly affects

decision: Second docked entry fails identically at 1a203ce, so the dock re-entry defect is not from this work
why: reproduced three times at HEAD and once at baseline with a warm session, same step and same not-hittable message

decision: Gave the controller an ENCHRON_DERIVED_DATA override so a runner can pin the build under test
why: the probe measured a stale build and reported it as current; no runner had a way to say which app to install
result: probe and matrix now measure the build under test

decision: Sustained device play delivered 3705 frames with zero deliveryLagRecovery events and no renderer failures
why: a four frame queue is the risk the byte budget buys, so starvation is the thing that had to be disproved

decision: Recorded the corpus codecs both gates were reporting as product drift
why: MPEG-2, VP9 and the extra MPEG-4 vectors land on classifications the baselines already accept for identical codecs

decision: Left the reachability baseline alone
why: accept-baseline writes a committed CI gate, and my first scoped run reported 215 known-defect and 0 reachable, which is the instrument not being set up rather than the product being unreachable

decision: Removed both worktree directories and kept their branches
why: the content is in HEAD, the vendored frameworks inside them were symlinks to the main checkout, and wt-ci stays because both CI workflows build from it

decision: Stopped driving the headset after it dropped the app to the background
why: appState runningBackground and an unhittable grid cell mean the device went idle unattended, not that the product regressed

decision: Two independent reviews flagged the same two defects in the new gate, so I fixed five
why: agreement between reviewers that did not see each other is the strongest signal available here, and all five reproduced in the code

decision: Deleted two VideoSampleProviderInfo fields I had added earlier the same night
why: a reviewer traced them as never populated and never read; the budget takes those facts from MediaSourceInformation

decision: pausedStartBeginsFirstFrameDeadlineOnlyAfterPlay failed once inside a gauntlet run and passed 12 of 12 in isolation
why: one appearance under full-suite load is not enough to call it either a flake or a regression, and it sits near the timing this change touched

decision: pausedStart flake did not recur in four more full-suite runs
why: one appearance in roughly eight runs; not enough to call a regression, not clean enough to call closed

decision: Predicate met except the reachability baseline, which is pre-existing and needs a device sweep I declined to guess at
why: every other gauntlet stage passes and the device confirmed playback across window, portal, panorama and docked
